verdict.rationale: Raygun documents ignore conditions for error groups: ignore for a time period, for a number of occurrences, or by rule. These directly cover the mute/ignore part of the story. Its 'Spike protection' is described as flagging irregular data volumes to avoid surprise usage, which is about billing and usage rather than alert suppression, and per-key rate limits are not evidenced at all. missing for 10: per-key rate limiting, spike protection that suppresses alerts or pages, evidence that ignore rules stop notifications, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can fight alert fatigue with spike protection, per-key rate limits, and mute/ignore rules so one bad deploy doesn't page the whole team all night

citations.quote: We provide three types of conditions: Ignore for a specific time period ... Ignore for a specific number of occurrences ... Ignore by rule
When you ignore an error group you can specify the condition you would like the error group to be ignored for.
Spike protection. Detect and flag irregular data volumes to avoid any surprise usage
